item.title: Liverpool seeks development partner for £65m heat network
item.description: “Liverpool is seizing a once‑in‑a‑generation opportunity to transform how our city is heated,” said Leader Cllr Liam Robinson. The post Liverpool seeks development partner for £65m heat network appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Iron Line hub heads packed Cumberland docket
item.description: Part of the £29m Millom Town Deal, a visitor centre at Hodbarrow Nature Reserve will be a feature of the coastal walkway, and is the standout item on a planning agenda also featuring a Premier Inn, a care home and affordable housing. The post Iron Line hub heads packed Cumberland docket appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: How Oldham is turning plans into places with momentum
item.description: Oldham has always been a place shaped by community, heritage and momentum, writes Emma Barton of Oldham Council. Since 2024, that momentum has been clear by the visible, on-the-ground delivery across the borough, where plans have become places and Oldham’s defining regeneration story is being told. The post How Oldham is turning plans into places with momentum appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Liverpool cues up May start for Walton Breck Road upgrades
item.description: The city council’s cabinet meeting next week is set to rubber-stamp a £4m package of highway improvements, part of its wider £250m regeneration programme for the Anfield area. The post Liverpool cues up May start for Walton Breck Road upgrades appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Arcadis makes Walsh healthcare sector lead
item.description: After more than five years at Ryder Architecture, Sheldon Walsh has started a new chapter with the global design and engineering practice. The post Arcadis makes Walsh healthcare sector lead appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Panattoni, Mitsui Fudosan unveil £135m Warrington warehouse plans
item.description: Coming in at a proposed 675,100 sq ft, the shed would sit on the former Iceland frozen food distribution site at Hardwick Grange. The post Panattoni, Mitsui Fudosan unveil £135m Warrington warehouse plans appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Trafford steps up asset sales programme
item.description: The local authority is seeking to offload further properties and set up joint ventures for others, with details of the 2026-27 disposal programme now revealed. The post Trafford steps up asset sales programme appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Court approves sale of DeTrafford’s stalled Salford development
item.description: A court has wiped clean the title of the failed Wavelength development, paving the way for Soller Group to buy the site and leaving investors short. The post Court approves sale of DeTrafford’s stalled Salford development appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Story Homes pushes on with 155-strong Worsley pitch
item.description: The housebuilder has lodged plans with Salford City Council within a wider development at Hazelhurst Farm, which it is taking forward with Taylor Wimpey following a deal with Peel Land last year. The post Story Homes pushes on with 155-strong Worsley pitch appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Triumph for the right to open windows in Penrith
item.description: Persimmon Homes has won its appeal against Westmorland and Furness Council to remove a planning restriction that required non-opening windows in bedrooms due to fears over noise from the nearby railway. The post Triumph for the right to open windows in Penrith appeared first on Place North West.
